newsitem.title: POLAND: Elektrim picks Merrill,Pekao to lead bond.
newsitem.headline: Elektrim picks Merrill,Pekao to lead bond.

text.p: Poland's industrial and trading conglomerate said it has signed an agreement with Merrill Lynch International and Polish Bank Pekao SA on placing its 550 million zlotys ($183.2 million) convertible bond issue.

"On January 31, (Elektrim) signed an agreement with Merrill Lynch International and bank Polska Kasa Opieki SA regarding the placement of convertible bonds worth up to an equivalent of 550 million zlotys," Elektrim said in a statement.
It said the bonds would be offered to Polish and foreign investors. It also said it wanted to list the convertible bonds on the Luxembourg stock exchange.
Last week, Elektrim said it planned to issue the paper as seven-year bonds and their pricing, denomination and other terms would be determined by the company's management.
